$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema URI; metadata only, never fetched by the server.

listen.description: IP address and TCP port; IPv6 uses brackets. Literal or runtime environment reference.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

auth.description: Single account credentials; configure either auth or users.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

username.description: Basic authentication username; literal or runtime environment reference. Resolved usernames must be unique.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

password.description: Basic authentication password; literal or runtime environment reference. Never exposed by configuration inspection.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

username.description: Basic authentication username; literal or runtime environment reference. Resolved usernames must be unique.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

password.description: Basic authentication password; literal or runtime environment reference. Never exposed by configuration inspection.

users.description: Authenticated users; configure either auth or users.

sessionResumptionTimeoutSeconds.description: Disconnected client session retention in seconds.

maxClientSessions.description: Maximum resumable client sessions per authenticated username.

maxTotalPlayers.description: Maximum allocated players across the server.

maxPlayersPerClient.description: Maximum players per client; cannot exceed maxTotalPlayers.

maxMessageBytes.description: Maximum RPC message size in bytes.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Request and handshake deadline in milliseconds.

maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Maximum requests per second per WebSocket.

media.description: Media access policy, evaluated on the server host.

allowedFileRoots.description: Server-local directories; relative to the config file. ~ expands at startup. Roots must exist and be directories; empty denies file playback.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

allowedUrlHosts.description: Allowed DNS hosts and subdomains. Empty denies URL playback; wildcard cannot be mixed with specific resolved hosts.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

items.description: Allowed DNS host and its subdomains, or * for all hosts. Literal or runtime environment reference.

allowHttp.description: Permit HTTP media URLs, subject to host and network policy.

blockPrivateNetworks.description: Reject media URLs resolving to private or reserved network addresses.

pluginHosts.description: Generic plugin-host deployments whose allowed operations can produce audio.

id.description: Stable, unique deployment ID used by clients.

enabled.description: Disabled hosts keep their configuration but are not registered as executable at startup.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

url.description: Discovery and execution origin; https unless allowHttp.

auth.description: Authentication sent only to the configured endpoint origin.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

token.description: Bearer token for the configured plugin-host origin; never sent to media URLs.

allowHttp.description: Permit http: endpoints and media origins.

mediaOrigins.description: Extra origins fetched without credentials; the endpoint origin is always included.

anyOf.description: Runtime environment reference, for example env('REMEDIA_RPC_PASSWORD'). Validation never resolves it.

items.description: HTTP(S) origin; literal or runtime environment reference.

allowExternalMedia.description: Allow descriptor URLs on other origins under the ordinary media.* policy.

replaySafe.description: Executing again has no side effects; enables retries and grant refresh.

operations.description: Explicit PLUGIN/OPERATION allowlist; object entries optionally set replaySafe, default false.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Connect and total deadline for each discovery or execute request, in milliseconds.

maxRequestBytes.description: Maximum serialized execute request in bytes.

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum discovery or execute response body in bytes.

maxPendingOperations.description: Maximum concurrent operation preparations for this host.

maxActiveStreams.description: Maximum concurrent media transfers for this host.

maxMediaBytes.description: Maximum bytes accepted for one media transfer.

mediaIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for the next media chunk, in milliseconds.

mediaBufferBytes.description: Per-stream queue between the network and the decoder, in bytes.

bitrate.description: Opus target bitrate in bits per second. Does not affect passthrough.

complexity.description: Opus encoder complexity; lower values trade quality for CPU. Default remains 9.

vbr.description: Allow variable bitrate for encoded Opus.

enabled.description: Allow clients to opt into crossfade; each session must also opt in.

prepareBeforeMs.description: Preparation lead before overlap begins, in milliseconds.

console.description: Enable console diagnostics; exporter configuration uses existing runtime environment settings.

description: Remedia server configuration. Unknown fields are rejected at every level. Environment references are resolved only by the Rust runtime.
